notes.title: ASURAJANG Season 1 Update
notes.content:
[p]On Thursday, July 17, 2025, from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM (UTC+9), a game update will be conducted.[/p][p]During the maintenance period for the update, you will not be able to access the game. Please take this into consideration when planning your gameplay.

Hello, ASURAJANG users![/p][p]Finally, the long Season 0 and Pre-Season are over, and the first regular season, Season 1, is about to begin![/p][p]We would like to express our deepest gratitude to all users who have waited patiently for this moment. As previously announced in the developer's notes, Season 1 includes numerous changes. Due to the volume of updates, we will first share a brief summary at the beginning, followed by detailed update notes in the latter section.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/7642290443b8e0ec9c46673ef9c4e6a666ab9fba.png"][/img][/p][h3][b][Summary of Major Changes][/b][/h3][olist][*][p]With the start of the new season, Season 0 records have been reset.[/p][/*][*][p]3v3 Arena Mode has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]A Rank Rating system has been introduced.[/p][/*][*][p]New character Brunn joins ASURAJANG![/p][/*][*][p]New character Erin joins ASURAJANG![/p][/*][*][p]A Pre-made Party Restriction feature has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]A Rank Placement system has been introduced.[/p][/*][*][p]An Account Icon system has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]A feature preventing party formation with blocked players has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The Battle Pass has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]XP gained from Missions have been significantly increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous new Achievement missions have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Character balance has been adjusted across the board.[/p][/*][*][p]The Asia server will be merged with the East Asia server.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3][b][Season 0 Records Reset][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Season levels have been reset.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of Battle Shards possessed by players has been reset.[/p][/*][*][p]Rankings have been reset.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][New Mode - Arena][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Arena Mode is a 3v3 mode where players engage in duels based purely on skill to determine the winner.[/p][/*][*][p]It is played in a series of rounds, where the first team to reach 3 round wins claims victory. A maximum of 5 rounds can be played before a victor is determined.[/p][/*][*][p]Rounds 1~3 are 3v3 team fights, while rounds 4~5 are tag team matches.[/p][/*][*][p]In Arena Mode, you do not participate using the character selected in the lobby; instead, there is a Character Pick Phase.[/p][/*][*][p]Teams with lower MMR start with the first pick, and subsequent picks alternate between teams. The player with the lowest MMR gets the first pick.[/p][/*][*][p]Picking the same character is not allowed.[/p][/*][*][p]Character combinations can result in significant advantages or disadvantages, so strategic character selection through active communication is advantageous.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/4baf6695c653a20f569a56bf21ea3c109d2d513c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/3d40f85017bc80d2230ef8996fd577b4e8fa1f41.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b][New System - Rank Tier System][/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Rank Tier System is a system applied to Battle Royale Mode and Arena Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Rank Tiers are divided into two leagues.[/p][/*][*][p]These are the [Challenge League] and [Master League].[/p][/*][*][p]The [Challenge League] consists of five tiers: Rookie, Initiate, Expert, Elite, and Champion.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [Challenge League], you earn RP, and when your RP reaches a certain score, you are promoted to the next rank.[/p][/*][*][p]When your RP reaches 3,500 or more, you are promoted to the [Master] rank and move to the [Master League].[/p][/*][*][p]The [Master League] is divided into three tiers: Master, Grand Master, and Asura.[/p][/*][*][p]Once you reach the [Master League], you cannot be demoted to a lower tier, and you begin earning CP points. Additionally, you must reach the [Master League] to be listed on the rank leaderboard.[/p][/*][*][p]If you enter the top 100 overall rankings in the [Master League], you will be granted the Asura rank. The Asura rank is updated once a day.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][Ranking Menu][/b][/h3][list][*][p]As explained above, only users who have reached the Master League will be listed in the rank leaderboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Users will now be displayed together across all servers, rather than separately by matchmaking server.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][New Character - Brunn][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Brunn from Vergerant joins ASURAJANG.[/p][/*][*][p]He is a character who fights with a giant partisan, characterized by his long range, powerful damage, and toughness.[/p][/*][*][p]Can be purchased using Fight Money or D-CREDIT, and is available for free for those who purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][New Character - Erin][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Erin from Vergerant joins the battle in ASURAJANG.[/p][/*][*][p]Erin is a mage character who uses elemental magic in cycles, and has various combos and crowd control abilities through element cycling.[/p][/*][*][p]Can be purchased using Fight Money or D-CREDIT, and is available for free for those who purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][Pre-made Party Restrictions][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Pre-made party restrictions have been introduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Players who have reached [Master League] in the ranks mentioned above will receive pre-made party restrictions.[/p][/*][*][p]Players in the [Challenge League] can form pre-made parties.[/p][/*][*][p]If a player in the [Master League] is in the party, matchmaking will be disabled.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][Placement Match System][/b][/h3][list][*][p]A Placement Match system has been introduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Applies to Battle Royale Mode and Arena Mode, and Placement Matches will be conducted over 5 matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Players' initial Rank Tiers will be determined based on the results of their Placement Matches.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][Account Icon System][/b][/h3][list][*][p]An Account Icon system has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Acquire Account Icons through various routes to express your individuality![/p][/*][/list][h3][b][Season 1 Battle Pass][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/4aeb1cd3f3321fb6a27664d49c3460aacdd27a6b.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]All Battle Pass items have been replaced.[/p][/*][*][p]The new Battle Pass can be purchased for 2,000 D-CREDIT.[/p][/*][*][p]When purchasing the Battle Pass, the Brunn and Erin characters are provided additionally.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of obtainable items has increased from 41 to 85.[/p][/*][*][p]You can receive 900 D-CREDIT from completing it.[/p][/*][*][p]You can obtain 10,000 Fight Money.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][Player Block Feature Improvement][/b][/h3][list][*][p]You will no longer be able to join the same party as blocked players.[/p][/*][*][p]The more you are blocked, the more likely you are to be excluded from party matching, which may result in longer matchmaking times.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][Mission Changes][/b][/h3][list][*][p]XP provided by missions have been increased by approximately 5 times compared to the previous version.[/p][/*][*][p]30 new Achievement missions have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Some missions with difficult requirements have been removed to make Daily Missions easier to complete.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][Matchmaking Server][/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Asia server has been merged with the East Asia server.[/p][/*][*][p]The existing Asia server had too few players, resulting in very little matchmaking.[/p][/*][*][p]We felt that maintaining the Asia server under these circumstances would only be detrimental to the player experience and ASURAJANG, so we decided that merging it with East Asia to increase the matchmaking pool was the right decision.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][Characters][/b][/h3][p][i]With the introduction of the arena, the importance of windup and recovery animations has become very significant. To address this, we have [b]adjusted the windup/recovery animations for all characters[/b]. Specifically, to distinguish between risk and reward, we have made it [b]impossible to cancel recovery animations following attacks with dodges[/b], which was previously possible. However, since the overall post-attack recovery animation length has been reduced, we anticipate that the sense of frustration will be slightly reduced. Additionally, to prevent jump attacks from becoming low-risk, high-reward actions, we have [b]increased jump stamina consumption[/b] and [b]adjusted jump attack stamina consumption and damage[/b]. Furthermore, we are improving actions that were statistically underused to make them more balanced. Please refer to the details below for more information.[/i][/p][h3][b]Common[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Jump stamina has been increased from 100 to 130.[/p][/*][*][p]The windup/recovery animations of all characters has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina recovery speed has been increased from 240 to 280 per second.[/p][/*][*][p]The stamina consumption of long-range actions has increased by approximately 10% to 15%. The actions that have been increased are as follows.[/p][list][*][p]Vikarala - Normal Action 1 and 2[/p][/*][*][p]Shoyo - All hits of Normal Action, Extra Action[/p][/*][*][p]Rei - Normal Action 1 and 2[/p][/*][*][p]Muimui - Normal Action 2 and 3[/p][/*][*][p]Bharata - All hits of Normal Action, Extra Action[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Payra[/b][/p][list][*][p]Parry window has been increased from 0.1 seconds to 0.12 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Payra's Extra Action has been separated into a parry and a slash.[/p][/*][*][p]After successfully parrying a melee attack, press the Extra Action key again to perform “Swift Slice,” in which Payra performs a wide slash as she did previously.[/p][/*][*][p]“Swift Slice” consumes stamina.[/p][/*][*][p]The hitbox duration of Normal Action 1 has been adjusted to match other characters.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hanuman[/b][/p][list][*][p]Extra Action 1 stamina consumption has increased from 300 to 350.[/p][/*][*][p]Extra Action 2 stamina consumption has increased from 100 to 150, and the damage has decreased from 360 to 300.[/p][/*][*][p]Special Action - Grab attack final hit DMG has increased from 240 to 300.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tetanuchi[/b][/p][list][*][p]Base HP has been changed from 1300 to 1200.[/p][/*][*][p]Movement speed has been increased from 420 to 450.[/p][/*][*][p]Tetanuchi is currently undergoing a full action design overhaul, and we will share further updates as they become available.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vikarala[/b][/p][list][*][p]Normal Action final hit’s DMG has been reduced from 250 to 220.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Rei[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dodge Attack DMG per hit has been increased from 40 to 50.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Baju[/b][/p][list][*][p]Extra Action Somersault Kick DMG has been increased from 175 to 200.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Kaisachi[/b][/p][list][*][p]Special Action stamina consumption has been slightly reduced overall.[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina consumed on the 1st use is 150, and increases by 30 each time her Special Action is used, up to a maximum of 270.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Yeoul[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dodge Attack explosion now lands 1.5m to the front of the character.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Shoyo[/b][/p][list][*][p]Normal Action 1 windup animation length has been slightly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Extra Action recovery animation length has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Dodge Attack recovery animation length has been reduced.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][Battle Royale - Items][/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Stun Gun and Grappling Hook now fire in the direction the character is facing (previously fired in the cursor direction), and their flight speed has been significantly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Mythic Astra - notes.title: Letter from D-ZARD
notes.content: [p]Greetings from the D-ZARD Team.[/p][p]As we prepare for Season 1, today we would like to discuss some things that members of the community may have been wondering about.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Regarding Early Access…[/b][/h2][p]We are well aware of the criticism we’ve received from many for not conducting Early Access to the game's launch. We fully understand how important Early Access is within the current Steam ecosystem.[/p][p]However, we would like to clarify that the decision to not conduct Early Access was not based on our company's own will.[/p][p]Our original release plan was as follows:[/p][p][b]Dec. 2024 Global OBT → Early Access → Season 0 → Season 1[/b].[/p][p]Our goal at D-ZARD was to stabilize the game through Early Access, developing and implementing Custom and Arena modes prior to Season 0 as test modes, and then officially release them with the launch of Season 0.[/p][p]However, contrary to our wishes, we were forced to completely change our plans due to external demands.[/p][p]Additionally, since we were operating our game simultaneously on a proprietary gaming platform that did not have an Early Access system, additional development unrelated to the game itself caused further delays in our schedule.[/p][p]After several rounds of persuasion, we were finally able to proceed with the following release plan: [b]Global OBT → Season 0 → Season 1[/b].[/p][p]However, as a result, we unfortunately lost our last opportunity to gain the understanding of players regarding the game's completion rate, and missed out on the opportunity to ship our game as Early Access and later launch the Official Release version.[/p][p]We believe that some responsibility definitely does fall on our company, D-ZARD, as well for not being able to make a stronger case at the time.[/p][p]While this was also disheartening for us as well, we felt it was important to address the many questions raised by industry insiders and players, rather than simply moving forward without any explanations. Therefore, we are providing this explanation, not as an excuse but simply to clarify matters.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Regarding Our Relationship With HIKE…[/b][/h2][p]There is a post on a certain community forum that summarizes our relationship with HIKE.[/p][p]While it is true that we collaborated with HIKE on certain tasks, there was no involvement in publishing-related work, nor were we affected by any internal issues within HIKE. We hope this clarifies any misunderstandings.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Regarding Development Speed…[/b][/h2][p]With the termination of services with our previous partner, we no longer need to coordinate schedules or discuss development directions with them, allowing us to develop more flexibly. However, due to the smaller scale of our Dev Team compared to other game companies, there will inevitably be differences in development speed. The Dev Team is working tirelessly day and night to accelerate development, so we kindly ask for your understanding if it may seem slow at times. Additionally, we would like to clarify that the claims circulating in certain communities, that the Dev Team is “ignoring user feedback” or “arbitrarily deciding update directions,” are completely untrue.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]In Closing...[/b][/h2][p]From the launch of Season 0 in March to now, we can't believe how quickly time has flown by. We have done our best to do what we can with our limited human resources and time, and we are still doing our best, but we recognize that there are many people who are not yet satisfied. We hope that the many things we have prepared for Season 1 of ASURAJANG will bring you some fulfillment, and we will continue to strive to make a better game. [/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.content: [p]Hello,[/p][p]This is the ASURAJANG team.[/p][p]First of all, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to all users who have been waiting for ASURAJANG Season 1.[/p][p]We have been working diligently to deliver the highly anticipated Season 1 update and new Arena content with the highest possible quality.[/p][p]However, during the final testing phase, we identified areas requiring additional improvements in terms of the stability and completeness of some systems.[/p][p]As a result, we have regrettably decided to adjust the Season 1 launch schedule as follows.[/p][p](All dates below are displayed according to the UTC+9 time zone)[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]■ Previous Schedule[/b][/h3][p][b]July 10, 2025 (Thu) – Season 1 Launch[/b][/p][h3][b]■ Revised Schedule[/b][/h3][p][b]July 17, 2025 (Thu) – Season 1 Launch[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]This Season 1 update does not stop at a simple content update, but also includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]the official introduction of a new battlefield known as the ‘Arena’[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]the addition of two new characters[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]This is a large-scale update aimed at providing an even more fresh and diverse combat experience.[/p][p]We know that many of you have been eagerly awaiting Season 1,[/p][p]and we at ASURAJANG feel a heavy sense of responsibility for having to postpone the release.[/p][p]However, rather than rushing to release the content in its current state,[/p][p]we have decided that it is the right choice to take an extra week to ensure stability and completeness before unveiling it to you.[/p][p]We are continuing to check everything to ensure that you can enjoy Season 1 to the fullest, and we will be back on July 17 with even more refined content.[/p][p]Once again, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to everyone for your patience and continued interest and support.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding.[/p][p]The ASURAJANG Team[/p]

notes.title: ASURAJANG Dev Notes - June 24, 2025

[p]Hello Everyone. This is Sangjin Kim, the Director of ASURAJANG.[/p][p]Today, I would like to share our plans regarding the end of Season 0 and the Free Season, as well as what you can expect from the upcoming Season 1.[/p][p]Season 0, which has taken place for about three months since the game’s launch, will conclude with the maintenance taking place on Thursday, June 26th[/p][p]Following this, there will be a [b]two-week Pre-Season[/b], and [b]Season 1 will officially begin on July 10th[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Season 0 Ranking Rewards[/h2][p]Season 0 Ranking Rewards will be distributed at the start of the Pre-Season, and the rewards are listed below.[/p][list][*][p]1st - Gold Trophy Remains / 1st Place Emoji[/p][/*][*][p]2nd - Silver Trophy Remains / 2nd Place Emoji[/p][/*][*][p]3rd - Bronze Trophy Remains / 3rd Place Emoji[/p][/*][*][p]~10th - Top 10 Emoji[/p][/*][*][p]~100th - Top 100 Emoji[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/d9c04dc21b9d856043ef9075e93f405b2a51e1be.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/0e03a8d1d2ccf6f7d1bd370a61f9a743d1320cd5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Pre-Season[/h2][p]A Pre-Season will be held from after Season 0 ends until the maintenance on July 10th. During the Pre-Season, we will be previewing [b][Team Deathmatch] [/b]mode. This will not be the finalized version, but we hope that you will enjoy experiencing another take on ASURAJANG’s combat experience. We look forward to hear your feedback.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Season 1 Major Changes[/h2][p]Season 1 marks the start of the first regular season and will run from July 10 to September 24.
The major changes in Season 1 are as follows.[/p][list][*][p][b]New Character Brunn[/b] joins the battle. Brunn is a melee character who uses a massive partisan, with thrusting attacks as his signature move. Despite being a close-range character, his slightly longer range is expected to give him an advantage in battles against other close-range characters.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/53286d9975c40fc383ac7e5b5e0cf58215b94012.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/ad005f4b34eccb19042846b2ecc10a29ae9122dd.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]New character Erin[/b] joins the battle. The [Team Deathmatch] mode was developed based on the idea that a mode was needed where players could casually learn the combat and characters' actions in ASURAJANG. It is played in a 3v3v3 format, and the team that defeats the most enemies within a 5 minute period wins. This will be a great opportunity to practice characters you may have found challenging in Battle Royale mode or experiment with various character combinations for the Arena.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rank Tier System[/b] will be introduced. Playing [Battle Royale] and [Arena] modes will increase your rank tier. The rank tier system consists of 8 tiers.[/p][/*][*][p]To celebrate the hot summer, a variety of swimsuit costumes will be available. We hope you look forward to them![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Event Preview[/h2][p]Finally, to mark the start of Season 1, a Pre-Registration and Returning Players Event will be held starting July 3rd.
Various rewards, including D-CREDIT, Fight Money, and Costumes, will be available, so we encourage everyone to participate.
We will share the participation details once the Pre-Registration page is open.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]This concludes this edition of the ASURAJANG Dev Notes.[/p][p]I will see you again in Season 1. Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: ASURAJANG UPDATE - June 12th, 2025
notes.content: [p]Greetings from the ASURAJANG Team. A game update will be performed on Thursday, June 12th, 2025, from 11 am to 1 pm (UTC+9). Please note that you will not be able to access the game during the update.[/p][p]  The update details are as follows. [/p][hr][/hr][h3][b][Dodge - Balance Changes][/b][/h3][p][i]The Dodge Action, designed as the only defensive action in ASURAJANG’s Combat System, enabled players to easily evade most attacks thanks to its high movement speed. After carefully monitoring the balance between Dodge and Attack actions for an extended period of time, we concluded that the Dodge action was significantly more effective than Attack actions, resulting in an imbalanced state where it was difficult to attack but easy to evade combat. Therefore, to restore the balance between offense and defense, we have decided to slightly reduce the overall effectiveness of Dodge actions, even if this means sacrificing some of the gameplay feel. In return, we will reduce the Stamina Cost of Dodge actions and increase the base value for Max Stamina to alleviate some of the frustration caused by Stamina limitations. Additionally, to prevent the difficulty of performing Perfect Dodges from increasing due to the reduced Dodge speed, we plan to slightly extend the Dodge window.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Travel distance of all characters' Dodge actions has been reduced by 15-20%. As a result, the speed of Dodge actions has also been reduced accordingly.[/p][/*][*][p]So-called “Bunny Hops,” which allowed players to travel larger distances quickly by Jumping while using a Dodge action have been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina Cost for all characters' Dodge actions have been reduced by around 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Base value for Max Stamina of all characters has been increased from 1,000 to 1,200.[/p][/*][*][p]Dodge Invincibility Period has been slightly increased from 0.075s to 0.085s.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b][Dodge Counter Attack Changes][/b][/h3][p][i]Dodge Counter Attacks have been tweaked to allow players to hit nearby targets more easily.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Attack Range Indicators are now displayed when holding the input key for Dodge Counter Attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]In order to make it easier to hit nearby targets, the forward travel distance when using Dodge Counter Attacks has been reduced by around 50%.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b][Character - Balance Changes][/b][/h3][p][b]▶ Hanuman[/b][/p][list][*][p]Movement speed while using his Extra Action has been reduced by around 8%.[/p][/*][*][p]Recovery animation length after using Extra Action 2 and upon landing after using his Aerial Extra Action have been increased slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug which allowed enemies to dodge his Ultimate Action by jumping has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▶ Tetanuchi[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dodge Attack hit distance has been reduced slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug which allowed enemies to dodge his Ultimate Action by jumping has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▶ Bharata[/b][/p][list][*][p]A bug which caused her movement speed to be boosted while in the “Supercharged” buff state has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▶ Vikarala[/b][/p][list][*][p]Recovery animation upon landing after using her Aerial Extra Action has been reduced slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]Ultimate Action tick DMG has been increased from 25 to 30, and Stamina loss per tick has been increased from 10 to 15.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage dealt when touching her Ultimate Action barrier’s edge has been increased from 150 to 200 DMG.[/p][/*][*][p]Dodge Counter Attack’s attack range has been increase from 8m to 10m.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▶ Payra[/b][/p][list][*][p]Parry difficulty has been slightly reduced. The Parry window now starts slightly earlier during the action’s animation and the length of the Parry window has been increased slightly from 0.09s to 0.1s.[/p][/*][*][p]The forward travel distance for the melee Parry follow-up attack [Blazing Crescent Slash] has been greatly reduced, making it easier to hit targets.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][[b]Battle Royale - notes.title: ASURAJANG Dev Notes - May 19, 2025
notes.content:
Hello Everyone. This is Sangjin Kim, the Director of ASURAJANG. 
Welcome to the second edition of the ASURAJANG Dev Notes!

Today, I would like to share some major changes that will be coming to ASURAJANG, including the reasons behind these changes, our current development status, future plans, and publisher changes.

[h3]First, starting with the maintenance on May 30th, we plan to temporarily remove the[b] [Battle Royale - Solos Mode].[/b][/h3]

Currently, ASURAJANG's maximum concurrent users (MCU) are around 200–400. This is below the minimum number required to maintain a PVP game, especially a Battle Royale game that requires a large number of players. In this situation, maintaining two Battle Royale modes simultaneously causes [b]extremely long matchmaking times.[/b] As a result, players have to wait too long to play a single game, which ultimately drives them away from the game. [b]What is even more critical is[/b] that new users who join the game become frustrated by the long matchmaking times or fail to experience games at their skill level, leading them to leave the game without being able to settle in.

Additionally, various issues have arisen in the Battle Royale Solos Mode and are expected to continue to arise in the future. “Teaming” behavior has become an issue amongst high-ranking users in Solos Mode matches, causing significant disruptions, and it continues to happen under the radar even now. Furthermore, certain users are persistently targeting streamers for harassment through “stream sniping” behavior (we plan to take strict action against such behavior upon detection in the future). Recently, [b]harassment[/b] using the game’s groggy system has also been witnessed.

While these issues can be largely attributed to design flaws, we believe that they occurred due to inherent issues with the Solos Mode. We have done our best to address these issues, but we have concluded that it will be difficult to improve the Solos Mode to a level that satisfies our users. In particular, while developing the Arena Mode and improving the issues of Battle Royale Solos, we realized that balancing the Trios Mode alongside these changes was an extremely challenging task. For the future of ASURAJANG, we have decided that temporarily closing the Solos Mode, which continues to face ongoing issues, and focusing on the Arena Mode is the best course of action. In the future, once the Arena Mode is well-established and there is a sufficient player base, we will consider reopening the Battle Royale Solos Mode. This was a difficult decision for us to make, but we have made it after careful consideration for the sake of maintaining ASURAJANG. We kindly ask for your understanding and patience.

The Rankings for Battle Royale Solos Mode will be determined by matches that take place before the maintenance on May 30th, and Rank Rewards will be distributed based on the rankings at that time when Season 0 ends.

[h3]Next, we would like to share details about the new features that will be added to Trios Mode.[/h3]
We aim to enhance the fun of Trios Mode and provide a more collaborative experience with others through various new features.

[list]
[*][b]The [Party Fill] feature will be added.[/b]
The Party Fill feature allows you to decide whether you wish to fill your party with up to two additional random players in Trios Mode or not. If you choose not to use Party Fill, you will enter Trios Mode with only your current party members. This means you can enter Trios Mode by yourself, and in this case, rewards will significantly increase, offering a high-risk, high-reward hardcore playstyle. Of course, you can also enjoy Trios Mode with just two party members as a Duo, and the rewards will be increased as well.

[*][b][Party Chat] feature will be added.[/b]
We are aware that proper teamwork is difficult with only a simple ping system as the only means of communication between party members. Adding in-game chat can be a double-edged sword, so we carefully considered its implementation, but ultimately decided to introduce it based on the judgment that the essence of an “online game” is communication with others.

[*][b]A feature [Preventing Members of Pre-made Parties from Picking the Same Character]will be added.[/b]
While selecting the same character in a pre-made party may not always result in an advantageous outcome, it can eliminate strategic options and lead to the selection of overpowered characters by multiple members of the same party, so we have decided to prohibit members of pre-made parties from selecting the same character. We also aim to prevent the characters from overlapping in random matchmaking as much as possible. However, strictly enforcing this could result in slower matchmaking for users who select popular characters, so we will not apply it too strictly.

[*][b][Smart Ping] feature will be added.[/b]
A Smart Ping feature that enables tactical communication will be added. This is expected to improve party combat effectiveness and survival rates by enabling more precise communication.

[b][*][Usernames] will be restored.[/b]
Usernames, which were replaced with character names due to Teaming issues in Solos Mode, will be restored.

[*][b][Party Recruitment] feature will be added.[/b]
We are preparing a feature that allows you to easily recruit party members and join parties in the Lobby. We are aware that pre-made parties may have an easier time winning than parties resulting from random matchmaking. There are various ways to address this issue, but separating pre-made parties and random parties in matchmaking could significantly increase matchmaking times, making it a risky approach to implement at this time. Instead, we will be trying to address this problem by making it easier for users with similar regions and MMR to form parties. We will provide more details on the solution for pre-made parties in a future edition of the ASURAJANG Dev Notes.
[/list]
[h3]Next, we will give a brief overview of the [b]Arena Mode[/b] that will be added after the end of Season 0.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/ae64ea7bcff8f387f6993fd338c1219b133fad1a.png[/img]
Arena Mode will consist of a Solos Mode and Trios Mode.
[b]Arena - Trios Mode[/b] is a 3v3 team fight mode that takes place over five rounds, with the first team to win three rounds securing the final victory. The early rounds are 3v3 team fights, while the later rounds are 1v1 tag team battles. Players in each team are not allowed to choose the same character, and they will choose characters in order of the lowest MMR. The reason the gameplay changes as the rounds progress is to add more strategic depth in terms of decision-making. Players will need to decide whether to optimize their team composition for 3v3 battles, mix characters that excel in 1v1 duels, or counter the characters selected by the opposing team, among other strategic choices.

[b]Arena - Solos Mode[/b] is a 1v1 duel game mode that consists of three rounds, with the first player to win two rounds securing the final victory. All three rounds are 1v1 duels, where players select two characters which are played in a tag team format. A key feature is the ability to tag in and tag out characters at set intervals. Victory is determined solely by individual skill, and we anticipate the emergence of various character combinations, mind games, tag-based combos, and counter-strats.

[h3]Finally, we would like to inform you that as of May 30, we have decided to part ways with our Japanese publisher GOP's Pmang, as well as DMM and Hange, which had been providing channeling services.[/h3]

Going forward, processes such as scheduling discussions with the publisher and game update review processes will be eliminated, allowing us to make faster decisions and provide content updates more promptly. To accommodate for this change, we plan to support the migration of Pmang platform users to Steam. Following the complete termination of service on May 30, we will hold an event where [b]Transparent Weapons[/b], previously available only to pre-registered Japanese players, will be distributed for free to all partcipating users at an appropriate time.

This concludes the second edition of ASURAJANG Dev Notes.

In the next developer's note, we will share more details about Season 1 and the New Characters that are currently in development.

Thank you.

notes.title: ASURAJANG Dev Notes - April 30, 2025

Hello Everyone, This is Sangjin Kim, the Director of ASURAJANG.
It is a pleasure to be able to greet you all in the first edition of the ASURAJANG Dev Notes!

It has already been a month since ASURAJANG was officially launched. It feels as if several months have passed already, but it's only been a month, which makes it feel like time is passing by slowly for me. That feeling is probably because I've been so busy identifying and solving the many problems that have arisen over the past month. I've listed the problems that have arisen so far below, and there sure have been a lot of them. 
[list]
[*] Payment issues, character balance issues, infinite combos, XP balance issues, Peach Trees and the HP Regen meta, one-shot combos, players getting stuck on the ground, players suddenly dying by falling, frequent disconnections during gameplay, teaming, client launch failures, cheat engine abuse, blinking, more balance issues, sudden ping spikes, and more.
[/list]
After reflecting on why so many issues arose, I have come to conclude it was because [b]we launched the game without fully completing preparations for Live Service. [/b]
In this respect, I would like to make an apology to all of the players who played ASURAJANG up until now. 

We are aware that many of our players are concerned about [b]whether ASURAJANG will be able to continue services.[/b] We also believe you may be curious about how committed the ASURAJANG Dev Team is to this project, which is why I am writing these Dev Notes. To put it simply, the Dev Team has not given up on ASURAJANG and plans to [b]continue improving the game[/b]. We believe that [b]ASURAJANG offers a special kind of entertainment[/b] that satisfies a specific niche, and we still see ample [b]potential and room for growth[/b]. With that in mind, I would like to explain the areas we have identified as priorities for improvement moving forward.

[b]First, we will be providing some essential PVP features.[/b]
We are currently developing an [b][Account Overview][/b] feature that allows you to view your play history and overall statistics. Now that your play is recorded, each game will have meaning. Additionally, your records will be displayed in an easy-to-understand statistical format. However, since we have not collected and stored all the data up to this point, data collection will begin once the feature is added. We kindly ask for your understanding and patience regarding this matter.

We are also developing a [b][Report][/b] feature that allows players to report malicious behavior such as hacking or teaming. We have found that because ASURAJANG offers a Solo Battle Royale mode, it is easy for teaming to occur. We consider teaming to be a highly detrimental act that ruins the game experience, so we plan to take strict measures against it. This is a feature that should have been included at launch, and we sincerely apologize for the delay. The reporting feature is scheduled to be introduced in May.

[b]Second, we will be introducing Ranked Matches.[/b]
We are currently hard at work developing the [b][Ranked Match][/b] system, which is an essential feature for PVP games, but is currently missing in ASURAJANG. As mentioned in various interviews, we are planning to implement Ranked Matches centered around the Arena mode. However, we are also aware that some players would prefer Ranked Matches for the Battle Royale mode. However, if we were to launch Ranked Matches for Battle Royale modes with a small player pool, it could lead to matchmaking delays due to players being spread out across matching pools. Therefore, we plan to first introduce Ranked Matches for Arena mode, which require fewer players, and then consider adding Battle Royale Ranked Matches once we determine that there is a sufficient player base to support them. Arena mode Ranked Matches are scheduled for testing in late June and to be officially launched in Season 1.

[b]Third, we will be introducing various Quality-of-Life(QoL) Improvements.[/b]
We are well aware that ASURAJANG's current QoL leaves something to be desired. Especially, new players often find it difficult to adapt to the game and tend to leave, which is a significant issue. We are currently developing various features to address this, and we plan to roll them out gradually. Additionally, we are working on improvements to make teamplay more seamless. For example, we are considering features such as notifications when a team member is under attack, the introduction of a smart ping system, and displaying the attack range of team members. We are also working on introducing various minor QoL improvements, such as allowing players to mute game sounds when the client is running in the background while keeping matchmaking notification sounds active, providing more detailed information in the Combat Info window, and displaying interactable level objects on the Battle Royale minimap. Additionally, the Xbox review is currently underway, and the PS review is scheduled to begin soon. With the introduction of console versions of ASURAJANG, we are preparing to improve controller responsiveness to ensure a seamless console gaming experience.

And I'm sure many of you are curious about the [b]Season 0 Rank Rewards[/b], so I'll take a moment to explain them now. Players who rank 1st, 2nd, and 3rd in Solo and Trio will receive a Ranking Trophy [b]Remains Appearance[/b] customization item.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/d9c04dc21b9d856043ef9075e93f405b2a51e1be.png[/img]

Additionally, [b]Emojis will also be provided[/b]. These emojis will be given to players who rank 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and within the top 10 and top 100 of both Solos and Trios modes. Since the rank rewards for Solos and Trios modes are the same, if players receive the same reward for the same rank, the rank reward item will only be provided once.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/0e03a8d1d2ccf6f7d1bd370a61f9a743d1320cd5.png[/img]

As a token of our gratitude to players who continue to play ASURAJANG to this day, we will provide the “No Retreat” emoji. Enter the following coupon code by the end of Season 0 to receive it:
[list]
[*] [b]ASURAJANG_NO_RETREAT[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/da216efeff2bba18946bdc091ed719734ef740eb.png[/img]

Finally, I would like to briefly introduce some characters that are currently under Development.
As you may have expected, Brunn and Erin will rejoin the battlefield with completely renewed actions.
Brunn will now use a Giant Partisan, instead of a long mace. He is being developed as a character whose combat style involves reading the flow of enemy attacks and exploiting openings.
Erin is a traditional mage character that utilizes various elemental magic, with the highest control difficulty among all characters introduced so far.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/029eacc7ec538cbfad4fbea19d2534ccfd01cb49.png[/img]
Additionally, Nadi and a Female Knight (name to be announced later) will be joining in Season 2. We will be revealing their action designs in a future edition of the ASURAJANG Dev Notes, so please look forward to them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/57e53780238cb4bc0c34866e9a992edb77371ae4.png[/img]
This concludes the first edition of the ASURAJANG Dev Notes. Thank you so much for reading this long post until the end.
I look forward to seeing you again in the next edition!

notes.title: ASURAJANG UPDATE - April 30th, 2025
notes.content:
[h3][Characters][/h3]
[list]
[*] Ryuan’s Extra Action and Aerial Extra Action’s recovery animation length was increased by 0.1s.
[*] The stumble animation is no longer played when Ryuan uses his Extra Action with Dark Flames Active to arrive at a mid-air location. 
[/list]
[h3][New System - Season Level Username FX][/h3]
[list]
[*] Special FX are now added to Usernames as the player’s Season Level increases.
[*] These FX only apply to players who have purchased the Battle Pass, and the displayed FX change every 50 levels. The max FX level is reached at level 200.
[/list]
[h3][New System - Play Guide Review][/h3]
[list]
[*] A new feature has been added that allows players to view past Play Guides.
[*] This feature can be accessed via the [Game Lobby] - [Menu] - [Play Guide].
[/list]
[h3][Elimination Buffs & Data Fragment Changes][/h3]
[i]Since Data Fragments were removed, we found that players no longer engaged in play behaviors related to occupying the surrounding space after an elimination, and were also no longer able to strategically share Data Fragments amongst Team members. Because we thought that Data Fragment drops led to more interesting play scenarios, we have made the following changes to Data Fragments. [/i]
[list]
[*] Players no longer receive a permanent buff when eliminating enemies. Only their HP and Stamina are restored.
[*] The amount of HP restored upon eliminating an enemy has been reduced from 30% to 10%.
[*] Data Fragments are now dropped upon elminating enemies.
[*] Dropped Data Fragments now disappear after 60 seconds pass.
[*] The Data Fragment inventory slot has been deleted, and Data Fragments are now picked up in regular Consumable slots. Due to this change, players are now able to hold a maximum of 4 Data Fragments.
[*] Upon consuming Data Fragments, characters receive the [Absorbed Data] buff, and 20% of their HP is gradually restored.
[*] The [Absorbed Data] buff has been adjusted from a “permanent boost to All Attack by 2%, Max HP by 20, and Max Stamina by 20” to a “permanent boost to All Attack by 3%, Max HP by 30, Max Stamina by 30, and HP Regen by 1”.
[/list]
[h3][New Enemy Elimination Rewards][/h3]
[list]
[*] Eliminated enemies now drop 1 Astra and 1 Consumable item.
[*] Players with more eliminations drop better items, with distinctions made between players with 0~3, 4~6, and 7 or more eliminations.
[*] Players with 7 or more eliminations drop 2 Astras.
[/list]
[h3][Element - Shock Effect Changes][/h3]
[i]We found that that the existing Shock Status Effect, that immobilized players when triggered, negatively impacted the experiences of both players who received and players who applied the Shock Effect to enemies. Therefore, we are making the following changes to the Shock Status Effect.[/i]
[list]
[*] The Shock Effect now reduces the Stamina Recovery Rate of affected characters. This effect can be stacked up to 3 times, and Stamina Recovery is reduced by at a rate of 20%, 40%, and 60% respectively.
[*] Electro Explosions now occur when players who are Shocked enter water. Electro Explosions cause AoE DMG and apply the Blow Away (Strong) effect to characters that are hit. Each stack increases the radius and DMG of the explosions.
[/list]
[h3][Battle Royale Consumables - Dudu Coin Changes][/h3]
[i]After the maximum number of Dudu Coins that could be held by players was increased to 9 coins, we found that players were pressured into spending a great amount of their play time farming for Dudu Coins, and the Dudu Vending Machines and Gacha Machines became priority farming spots. Additionally, in Trios, we found that players were much less likely to use Vending and Gacha Machines due to their tendencies to farm in separate locations. As we had originally intended for Dudu Coins to serve as a supplementary method of farming to item drops, and to alleviate the pressure for players to spend their time farming for Dudu Coins, we are making the following changes.[/i]
[list]
[*] The maximum number of Dudu Coins that can be carried has been reduced from 9 to 5 coins.
[*] The number of Dudu Coins held by Party Members is now displayed.
[*] The number of Dudu Coins dropped by defeated Mimic enemies has beed reduced from 2 per Mimic and 3 per Rare Mimic to 1 per Mimic and 2 per Rare Mimic. 
[*] The Respawn Time for Mimic enemies has been adjusted to a fixed 150s duration.
[*] The drop rate of Dudu Coins from Urns has been increased.
[*] The drop rate of Dudu Coins from common Dudu Chests has been slightly increased.
[*] The number of items obtained from interacting with Dudu Gacha Machines and Vending Machines has been adjusted to 2 items, regardless of the number of coins inserted.
[*] The types of Astras that can be obtained from Dudu Gacha Machines have been adjusted as listed below.
[list]
[*] 1 Coin → Uncommon, Rare
[*] 2 Coins → Rare (High rate), Epic, Legendary (Very Low rate)
[*] 3 Coins → Rare, Epic, Legendary (Low rate)
[*] 4 Coins → Rare, Epic (High rate), Legendary
[*] 5 Coins → Epic, Legendary (High rate)
[/list]
[/list]
[h3][Battle Royale - Minimap][/h3]
[list]
[*] The locations of nearby Vending Machines, Gacha Machines, Healing Plants, Dark Spore Plants, and Mimic enemies within a certain range are now displayed on the Minimap.
[/list]
[h3][Locker][/h3]
[list]
[*] The Selected Character is now displayed in the Locker.
[*] The slot an Emoji/Emote item is equipped to is now displayed in the Locker.
[/list]
[h3][Sound][/h3]
[list]
[*] The ASURAJANG Game Client’s sound is no longer played when the ASURAJANG Client is running in the background. 
[*] As an exception, the notification sound that is played when Matchmaking is complete is still played while the game client is running in the background.
[/list]
[h3][Battle Royale - Level Objects][/h3]
[list]
[*] The number of Peach Trees that spawn per match has been reduced from 12 to 10 trees.
[*] Dark Mist Spore Plants now spawn in random locations.
[*] Dark Mist Spore Plants now release Dark Mist Spores upon being popped. The Dark Mist Spores are released in the direction the Plant was facing, and they explode after traveling a set distance. Enemies hit are Knocked Down and Nearsighted for a set time.
[/list]

notes.content:
Greetings from the ASURAJANG Dev Team. 

A minor balance patch will be introduced on April 5th, at 10:00AM (KST+0).

The ASURAJANG Dev Team is doing our best to quickly analyze the gameplay trends, as well as issues that players are reporting, to improve them. We are trying to deal with the issues as quickly as possible, but we are prioritizing the issues that are most urgent, so it may take some time for each player to see the changes they want. We ask for your patience and understanding. 
Thank you.

[*] Play XP adjustment - the amount of Survival XP received per each minute of survival in a match has been increased from 100 to 150.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Additional DMG received when attacked while [Burned] was adjusted from 8/11/14/17/20% →  5/8/11/14/17%
[*] Duration of [Bleeding] status effect was adjusted from 8s → 6/7/8s.
[*] [Shocked] status effect was changed from receiving 80 DMG over a period of 7s at random intervals of 1~3s→  receive 120 DMG once at a random interval within 2s.
[/list]

[list]
[*] The wall landing animation of characters who hit walls after being Blown Away has been changed from a stand up animation to a roll animation. [*] Dodge Attack can now attack enemies that are low in the air.
[*] Fixed an issue where his Dodge Counter Attack did not register hits on enemies in certain situations.

[list]
[*] Ultimate Action Gauge now requires slightly more energy to be filled.
[/list]

Building on the results of the numerous tests we've conducted so far, we are thrilled to finally announce the official launch of ASURAJANG!

[list]
[*] In-game, this is called the "Purgatory" system.
